notes.title: Dark Invasion VR - Fresh update!
notes.notes:
What's new?

Infected zombies now have tentacles, claws and etc.

Updated the effect of teleporting zombies and aliens.

The order of passing the levels has appeared.

notes.title: Update turn options!
notes.notes:
*Now in the game options, you can choose the type of turn!
